author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
You'll each need your own wayvessels built to use other people's. The main benefit at low levels is more access to dungeons, shops, and NPCs for quests. Sharing raids is possible too once you're high enough level. 


Anyone in your current party has to activate their wayvessel (activates for up to 24h) and then party members can teleport back and forth from their own wayvessel to a party members with a 1hr cool down on teleporting. Mostly this is used for dungeon clearing parties where everyone opens as many group dungeons as possible for max loot.
